task.title: Configure browser access and defaults
task.shortdesc: Use Step 2 to configure browser access, network behavior, and baseline defaults.

prereq.p: A Guided profile draft is open.

context.p: Browser access & defaults collects controls that shape whether Firefox can reach resources and how it behaves before content-specific policy choices.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Review network access and browser behavior controls for the deployment.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Set baseline defaults before adding home, search, or navigation-specific choices.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Validate warnings shown next to schema-dependent controls.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The profile has intentional browser access and default-behavior settings.

postreq.p: Recovery: if validation flags a value, undo the last change or use All settings to inspect the raw policy shape.
